lines.text: Dana checked the forecast the night before.
By noon on the ridge, the wind picked up and gray clouds rolled in fast.
In fall, mountain weather can turn in a few hours.
Here's the fix. Check the forecast again on the morning drive, for the mountain, not the town below.
Decide your turnaround signs before you start, like rising wind or dark clouds.
She turned back early and beat the rain.
Save this before your next fall hike.
